allImages.caption: Alban Cutler's property can be seen on the left overlooking the Susquehanna (though his name is mis-spelled.) Wynona Lamborn's home with her Uncle Tommy Hambleton and Aunt Lib is the location of the Fernglen Store and P. O. The Drumore Friends Meetinghouse and some other places we've talked about are also highlighted. Uncle Frank Tennis and Aunt Lucy live at the property where he grew up and which was inherited by his older brother, Samuel.
